contexts.text: The moles and the bats () = those who are in darkness; that is, in falsities and the derivative evils. AC 9424:6.
To bow themselves to the moles and the bats () = to worship such things as are in thick darkness and in the shade of night, which is [to worship] external things without an internal.
Before the eyes of angelic Spirits, some were seen as bats; some as owls; some as moles... and they fled away into their darkness... TCR 162:5.
He then sees truths no more than a mole.
The evils and falsities of doctrine from which is their worship are signified by the moles and the bats (), because their sight is in darkness, and they shun the light.
